summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 0.70. prof.kaya@aegean.edu shows 10/11 successful sign-ins from a consistent pattern: Portugal (Lisbon, MEO ASN), via VPN appliance vpn-edge-02, device LT-3104, apps mail/lms, zero MFA prompts — consistent with a faculty member travelling abroad using their known device + VPN. One outlier sign-in from Turkey (Manisa, Turkcell mobile ASN), no device_id, not via VPN, app mail, zero MFA prompts. This deviates from the established device/VPN/geographic pattern but is a single event with no failed authentications, MFA fatigue, impossible travel against a confirmed location, or follow-on mail activity to confirm account takeover. The travelling-abroad context provides a partial explanation but does not fully account for the missing device/VPN and different country/ASN. Evidence is insufficient for contain (no confirmed takeover) and not clearly benign (unexplained deviation); no exposure requiring human escalation. Weak unexplained signal -> monitor.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
